summary: This is the README of the archived ros-tooling/rosbag2_storage_mcap GitHub repository, which provides a rosbag2 storage plugin adding support for the MCAP file format. It explains installation via apt for ROS 2 distributions, using MCAP with ros2 bag record, play and info commands, and configuring the MCAP writer through a YAML options file or preset storage profiles (fastwrite, zstd_fast, zstd_small). The repository has been archived and development moved to ros2/rosbag2.
one_line: README for the archived rosbag2_storage_mcap plugin, which adds MCAP file format support to ROS 2 rosbag2 with writer options and presets.
key_facts: The rosbag2_storage_mcap repository was archived by its owner on Nov 30, 2022 and is now read-only.
Development of rosbag2_storage_mcap continues at github.com/ros2/rosbag2 under the rolling branch rosbag2_storage_mcap.
rosbag2_storage_mcap is a storage plugin for rosbag2 that extends it with support for the MCAP file format.
On Ubuntu, rosbag2_storage_mcap can be installed with 'sudo apt install ros-humble-rosbag2-storage-mcap' after following the ROS 2 installation instructions.
Recording with MCAP storage uses the command 'ros2 bag record -s mcap /topic1 /topic2', where -s mcap is the abbreviation of --storage mcap.
The MCAP writer is configured for ros2 bag record with the --storage-config-file option pointing to a YAML file describing mcap::McapWriterOptions.

The fastwrite preset is configured for the highest write throughput and lowest resource utilization, does not calculate CRCs, and does not write a message index, and is useful for resource-constrained robots.
The zstd_fast preset uses zstd chunk compression at the lowest compression ratio with chunk CRC calculation disabled, equivalent to compression Zstd, compressionLevel Fastest, and noChunkCRC true.

The zstd_small preset writes 4MB chunks compressed with zstd at the highest compression ratio (compressionLevel Slowest) and calculates chunk CRCs, and is useful with ros2 bag convert as a post-processing step.
The README advises that MCAPs written with fastwrite are not recommended as long-term storage because reading messages from a subset of topics or seeking may not work without a message index.
The repository is licensed under Apache-2.0 and was written mainly in C++ (87.8%) with CMake (12.2%).
The repository had 30 stars, 5 forks, 0 open issues and 9 contributors at the time the page was captured.
The noChunking option, when true, writes Schema, Channel and Message records directly into the Data section instead of Chunks.
